name: Strategic Planning / Southeast Task Force Committee Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I
  Strategic Planning Committee I Southeast Task Force
  will conduct a Regular Meeting, at the following time and place,
  and will address the agenda listed below:

  CITY HALL
  455 North Rexford Drive
  2’ Floor, Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, June 10, 2019
  5:00 PM

  AGENDA

  1)  Public Comment
  a.  Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.

  2)  Welcome and Introduction

  3)  Discussion of Commercial Uses in the Southeast Area of Beverly Hills

  4)  Activity and Feedback

  5)  Adjournment
  The next meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task Force is
  scheduled for July 8, 2019.

  Lou rdes Sy-Rodriguez, Assist  tCity Clerk

  Posted: June 4, 2019

minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Council Chamber
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Strategic Planning/Southeast Taskforce/Committee Meeting

  HIGHLIGHTS

  Monday, June 10, 2019
  5:00 PM
MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time  June 10, 2019 / 5:00pm

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor John Mirisch, Councilmember Julian Gold, City Treasurer
  Howard Fisher, Assistant City Manager Nancy Hunt-Coffey,
  Director of Public Works Shana Epstein, Director of Community
  Development Susan Healy Keene, Assistant Director of Community
  Development Ryan Gohlich, Senior Planner Timmi Tway,
  Marketing and Economic Sustainability Manager Laura Biery,
  Policy and Management Analyst Cindy Owens, Blair Schlecter
  (Chamber of Commerce), Vicki Talbot (Beverly Hills Courier), Mark
  Elliott, Sharon Ignarro, Pam Kerns, Stan Rosenburg, Corey Shaffel,
  Cindy Shaffel, Susan Michler, Rabbi David Baron, Andrea
  Grossman, Steve Mayer, Abraham Assil

  1)  Public Comment
   None:

  2) Welcome and Introduction
   Brief introduction from committee attendees

  3) Discussion of Commercial Uses in the Southeast Area of Beverly Hills
   Presentation by City staff
   Discussion between stakeholders regarding the types of businesses that
  could thrive within the area
   Discussion on zoning alternatives

  4) Activity and Feedback
   City staff conducted a survey prior to the meeting. The results were
  discussed by those in attendance. Staff collected feedback on committee
  Preferences in relation to the survey.

  5) Adjournment
  The next meeting of the Strategic Planning Committee/Southeast Task Force is
  scheduled for July 8, 2019

  Adjourn
 Date / Time  June 10, 2019 / 6:00pm
